remarks: Summer fun in Ellicottville starts now, and you just hit the jackpot with this studio condo at Holiday Valley! One of the most affordable ways to start enjoying the ski town lifestyle, let the stress melt away with seamless access to the pool complex, cabana bar, golfing, skiing, and some of the best hiking and biking in Western New York. Set for a full interior update prior to the 2026-27 ski season, this 475 square foot unit sleeps four comfortably, between its queen bed and pull-out couch. The kitchen features granite countertops with an oven, dishwasher, and full refrigerator. You’ll also find perfectly appointed spaces for dining, cozying up in front of the fireplace, storage, and a spacious bathroom. As part of a time share rotation, you’ll get one full week to enjoy your unit every fifth week. Can’t make your assigned week? Swap for a similar unit, a week that works better, or rent your unit out for extra income. Owner amenities include underground parking, a private storage locker, exclusive use of the club’s fitness center, sauna, swimming pool, and hot tub. Located in the Tamarack Club at Holiday Valley Resort, take advantage of low carrying costs and start enjoying Ellicottville, today!
